| What to find | Where to look | Notes |

| **Earliest pre‑2015 paper** for the author who qualifies | Sort the qualifying author’s list by year (ascending) | Record the exact title (and year, for sanity check). |

### 3. FACTS TO DERIVE (once the lookup is complete)  
1. **Identify the qualifying author** – the one whose publication list contains at least one entry dated earlier than 2015.
